steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Metal finishes - functional: galvanising (zinc coating prevents rust), anodising (thickened aluminium oxide layer - harder, can be dyed), plating (chromium/nickel for hardness). Decorative: powder coating (baked polymer - durable, many colours), painting (versatile but less durable).

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Timber finishes - functional: preservative (prevents rot), fire retardant. Decorative: varnish (clear, highlights grain, waterproof), oil (penetrates wood, natural), wax (soft sheen, less durable), paint (opaque, hides grain), stain (changes colour, shows grain).

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Polymer finishes - self-finishing (coloured in the mould). Surface: printing (pad, screen, hot-foil), texturing (etched mould surfaces), vacuum metallising.

steps.title: Key Fact
steps.body: Textile finishes - functional: waterproofing (DWR coating), flame retardancy, stain resistance. Decorative: dyeing, printing, embroidery, applique.

steps.title: Check your answers
steps.body: Steel contains iron which rusts. Galvanising coats with zinc - zinc corrodes sacrificially, protecting exposed iron even if scratched. Oil: penetrates wood, warm natural look, easy to repair, water-resistant but not waterproof, | Pad printing: transfers ink via silicone pad - excellent for curved/irregular surfaces, small to medium logos, fine detail.
